The '''Orranana system''' was located in the [[Cadma sector/Legends|Cadma sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Orrananan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Xim" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Orranana system was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed it in grid square T-8.<ref name="EAOC" />
